chars.FOUAD: FOUAD: a 24-year-old Moroccan young man wearing a bright yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers.
chars.HASSAN: HASSAN: a big rich Moroccan farmer wearing a white djellaba, a straw farmer hat with a wide brim and a thick gold watch.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a lilac headscarf and a long denim dress.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Comic split composition divided by a jagged line: in the upper half HASSAN stands in his farm yard full of cows, holding a fan of banknotes and kissing his smartphone screen with little floating hearts; in the lower half FOUAD sits in a tiny clothing shop in a Casablanca alley, staring at his phone with a sly cheeky grin. Funny, mischievous mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HASSAN in front of his big farmhouse, excitedly pulling a thick bundle of banknotes from his djellaba pocket while holding his phone, big generous happy expression, cows behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: FOUAD jumping with joy inside his small clothing shop full of hanging t-shirts, both arms up, phone in one hand, ecstatic.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: FOUAD sitting on a stool in his shop, frozen, sweating, a hand on his head, realizing he is in trouble, staring at his phone. Comic worried expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Casablanca popular alley (derb) with old doors: FOUAD standing at the green door of SALMA's house, showing her his phone and smiling nervously; SALMA in the doorway looking at him suspiciously.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the same derb alley, SALMA crossing her arms and turning her face away, refusing; FOUAD in front of her with his hands pressed together begging dramatically. Comic.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, FOUAD lying on a bed in his small bedroom, typing on his phone with a fake sweet shy pose, legs kicking in the air like a teenage girl, lamp light. Funny.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, FOUAD sitting up on his bed in panic, eyes wide, holding his phone far from himself as if it were a bomb, the phone showing a ringing microphone icon shape. Comic shock.
